newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar pinioned in ranges, needs news.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar pinioned in ranges, needs news.

text.p: White sugar futures was handcuffed in tight ranges on Monday afternoon in a market that shrugged off the arrival of March as the new spot contract and looked for fresh fundamental news to spur activity.

Traders said commission house buying of the spot March contract was offset by light trade sales, leaving the position's value in a tight $1.40 range. They also noted scattered crossed trades by commission houses in both the March and the May contracts which boosted the overall volume, but said the day's session was dull with the New York market failing to give any cue for fresh sentiment.
"It's not doing one thing or the other," one trader said. At 1655 GMT March was up just 30 cents at $302.50 and May was up 20 cents at $303.20. Market volume amounted to 993 lots.
Activity in Paris was extremely thin with just 190 lots posted on the board. March was unchanged at $303.00 and may down 50 cents at $303.50.
